name: GitHub MCP Server
tagline: GitHub's official MCP server for repos, issues, and PRs.
description: Connects an MCP client to GitHub so the agent can read repositories, manage issues and pull requests, search code, and work with Actions. Available as a GitHub-hosted remote server or a local Docker image.
author: GitHub
notes: Remote endpoint needs a compatible MCP host. Local install uses the public GHCR image.
